description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}.
Planar Void and Sifter of Skulls triggers.
Resolve the Planar Void trigger, exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Eldrazi Spawn, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Repeat.
